name: Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with tender chicken, aromatic spices and caramelised onions. Served with raita.

name: Veg Thali
description: Wholesome plate with rice, dal, two curries, roti, salad and pickle. The perfect balanced meal.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Rich, creamy tomato-based curry with soft paneer cubes. Best enjoyed with naan or rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed basmati rice with scrambled eggs, mixed vegetables and soy seasoning.

name: Masala Chai
description: Classic Indian spiced tea brewed with ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and strong Assam tea leaves.

name: Cold Coffee
description: Chilled blended coffee with milk and a hint of vanilla. Thick, creamy and energising.

name: Mango Lassi
description: Sweet and tangy blended yoghurt drink with Alphonso mango pulp. Refreshing and filling.

name: Lemon Soda
description: Freshly squeezed lemon with chilled soda, a pinch of black salt and mint. Perfect on a hot day.

name: Samosa (2 pcs)
description: Crispy golden pastry filled with spiced potato and peas. Served with tamarind and mint chutney.

name: Vada Pav
description: Mumbai's iconic street food — a spiced potato fritter in a soft bun with dry garlic chutney.

name: Bread Omelette
description: Two-egg masala omelette served between buttered bread slices. A canteen breakfast classic.

name: French Fries
description: Crispy golden fries seasoned with chaat masala and served with ketchup. Great with any drink!
